IC1: 1. Histologically diagnosed high-grade serous [OR] or endometrioid ovarian cancer (including primary peritoneal [OR] and fallopian tube cancer)
IC3: 3. Complete response (CR) [OR] or partial response (PR) achieved with last platinum-based chemotherapy regimen as determined by investigator
IC4: 4. Ability to be randomized ≤8 weeks after last dose of platinum
